summary: Pasithea Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, announcing that its publicly traded warrants (Nasdaq: KTTAW) will expire September 17, 2026 under the Warrant Agency Agreement with VStock Transfer, LLC as warrant agent. Unexercised warrants will become worthless and cease trading on Nasdaq, with a Form 25 filed to delist and deregister the warrants under Section 12(b). Common stock (KTTA) continues trading on Nasdaq. No board recommendation, advisor, or pricing terms are disclosed, making this an administrative warrant-expiry delisting event; watch for late exercises, potential fractional-value distribution, and a possible balance-sheet cash infusion before expiry.
